thread:
nina (AE): heads up — DeltaBank wants a 10-business-day pilot. scope: invoice extraction + policy Q&A for support agents. asks: sample prompts, acceptance criteria, security posture for uploads, and POC pricing.

rahul (SE): got it. i'll produce a starter prompt inventory (20-30 prompts) covering: messy OCR, missing totals, multi-currency, and line-item splits. need sample OCR text format.

nina (AE): customer will provide OCR text (tiff->ocr->txt). i'll attach 10 anonymized pages in the drive.

ana (ML Eng): for baseline prompts i suggest strict-json mode and a QA retrieval prompt for policies. example extractor prompt:
```
System: Extract JSON only: vendor, invoice_date(YYYY-MM-DD), total, currency, items[]. Provide per-field confidence 0-1.
User: <OCR_TEXT>
```

and policy QA prompt:
```
System: Answer only from the supplied docs. If unsure, reply "No answer found." Keep under 120 chars.
User: <question>\n
```
these are good for automated evals.

chris (Pricing): POC credits: we can cover up to 50k tokens/day for 2 weeks. if concurrent demo users >8 we should discuss a temporary dedicated pool. need SE to estimate tokens per request.

rahul (SE): estimate: avg input 350 tokens, output 120 => ~470 tokens. peak concurrency 8-12 during demos. batching likely reduces cost.

maya (Security): delta bank requires: customer-managed KMS (preferred), VPC peering, and audit logs retained 90 days. for POC we can accept short-term managed keys + redact PII in logs. will draft minimal answers for their questionnaire.

leo (CSM): timeline + owners proposal: 1) prompt inventory + sample outputs (rahul) — 48h, 2) eval harness + thresholds (ana) — 72h, 3) security Q answers & one-pager (maya) — EOD, 4) pricing note & credits (chris) — 24h, 5) customer kickoff w/demo plan (nina+leo) — within 3 days.

ana (ML Eng): thresholds suggestion: vendor & total exact-match >= 90%, hallucination rate < 4% on policy Qs, median latency p50 < 500ms for extraction. cost target: <= $0.03 per request.

nina (AE): customer asked about fallback if model fails — can we provide deterministic regex fallback for critical fields?

rahul (SE): yes. implement fallback for total/currency/invoice_date with heuristics. include a "used_fallback" flag in response.

maya (Security): note: allow synthetic data for week1, gated real uploads week2 after DPA. i'll include language and minimal POC controls in one-pager.

chris (Pricing): i'll confirm credits and send a small note about overage pricing and optional reserved rates.

leo (CSM): action items noted. i'll create a shared folder and calendar invite. please update thread when deliverables uploaded. thanks! :rocket:
